subject: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a short proposal for expanding the account to include four additional internal projects (analytics, agent-platform, clinical-ui, and batch-ingest). High level: we can provision separate API key namespaces for each project, add a second key rotation schedule for security, and increase committed capacity by 30% to keep latency stable for peak runs.

Attachments: northernlabs_expansion_capacity_plan.xlsx (capacity forecast + rate limit table)

Quick bullets:
- New project keys: 4 distinct namespaces (project-scoped keys)
- Staggered activation: two projects in month 1, two in month 2
- Committed throughput: +30% (monthly token commitment) with a mid-term check after 90 days
- Renewal: propose 12-month renewal to align discounts with expansion (we show a 10% expansion discount on top of current rates)

Can you confirm the project owners and whether you want separate environments (prod / staging) per project? If yes, we’ll include those in the key naming convention and the SOW.

Next step: if you’re good, I’ll loop in Monica (Customer Success) to scope rollout tasks and Laura (Legal) for a short addendum to the existing contract.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

Ben —

Appreciate the rapid follow-up. This looks good at a glance. A couple of clarifications before we commit:

1) We want project-level key segregation and separate staging/prod keys for at least the agent-platform.
2) Staggered activation is preferable (helps our rollout team).
3) On pricing: the 10% expansion discount sounds reasonable but procurement will want to see the updated contract with the term change called out.

I’m looping in Sasha (tech lead) and procurement so they can review security and PO constraints.

Thanks — I’ll aim to get back with confirmed project owners by Monday.

Best,
Evan Ruiz
Director of Product, NorthernLabs
evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

Evan — thanks. Looping in Monica, Laura and Marissa to align the rollout, SOW, and legal addendum.

Proposed rollout (high level):
- Week 0: SOW & addendum sign (DocuSign) + project owner list finalization
- Week 1–2: Prod/staging key creation + naming convention + short handover doc for your infra team
- Week 3–6: Integrations for first two projects (analytics, agent-platform) — smoke tests and KV cache sizing
- Month 2: Second wave for clinical-ui and batch-ingest + monitoring runbook handed over

Pricing summary (attached in SOW):
- Base renewal term: 12 months (aligns discounts and expansion incentives)
- Committed tokens: current + 30% for 12 months; overages billed at standard rate (with burst policy)
- Expansion discount: additional 10% applied to committed token price for the added capacity

Attachments: redwood_sow_v2.pdf (draft SOW + pricing table)

Action items for NorthernLabs: send final list of project owners and confirm whether agent-platform needs separate staging/prod keys.

Monica — can you prepare an onboarding checklist & estimated time per integration (hours) for the four projects? Marissa — if we need to approve a one-time enablement discount, lmk. Laura — we’ll need a short addendum to update term and committed capacity.

Thanks all,
Ben

From: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@northernlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>, procurement@northernlabs.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

On Mon, Sep 12, 2027 at 10:22 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed rollout (high level):
> - Week 0: SOW & addendum sign (DocuSign) + project owner list finalization
> - Week 1–2: Prod/staging key creation + naming convention + short handover doc for your infra team

Thanks for the summary. A few technical questions from our side:

- Key scoping: can project keys be bound to a namespace with explicit rate caps (we prefer enforcement at the gateway level)?
- Rate limits: with +30% committed throughput, what are the burst policies for short spikes (>5 sec token bursts)?
- Data residency & logging: we need confirmation that logs for these projects will stay in the us-east region and that audit logs for key use are retained 180 days.
- SOC2 evidence: can you point me to the SOC2 report and a short list of what evidence we can expect (e.g., key rotation policy, access control lists)?

If you can provide short, technical answers and the SOC2 evidence link I’ll circulate to procurement.

Thanks,
Sasha Kim
Senior Staff Engineer (Platform) | NorthernLabs
sasha.kim@northernlabs.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

Evan / Ben —

I’ve reviewed the draft SOW and prepared a short addendum with redlines. Primary points:
- Term: update to a 12-month renewal aligned to the expansion start date
- Committed capacity: reflect the +30% commitment and add a 90-day utilization review clause (either party may re-negotiate capacity after review)
- Pricing: capture the 10% expansion discount on added capacity only (not retroactive)
- Data & logging: include explicit retention of audit logs for 180 days and a clause referencing Redwood’s SOC2 Type II report (link included in evidence stub)

I’ve uploaded redlined SOW to the DocuSign envelope (link will be emailed to your procurement contact). Once NorthernLabs confirms, we’ll circulate for signature.

Attachments: redwood_sow_v2.pdf (redlined), soc2_evidence_link.txt (link to secure folder)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@northernlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Kim <sasha.kim@northernlabs.com>, procurement@northernlabs.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NorthernLabs expansion: additional projects, API keys, and renewal terms

Ben / Laura —

Thanks to everyone for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the redlines and is comfortable with the 12-month term and the 90-day utilization review. Technical review looks good after Sasha’s questions were answered offline (key scoping and retention confirmed).

We approve the plan and will sign the DocuSign as soon as we receive the envelope. Please:
- Send invoice for the initial committed capacity increase (PO to follow)
- Schedule a kickoff with Monica and Sasha next Tuesday (Sep 21) at 10am PT — that works for our infra and rollout leads

Procurement contact: procurement@northernlabs.com (cc’d) — please include PO instructions in the DocuSign email.

Appreciate the team’s help — excited to get these projects live.

Best,
Evan
